final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, l.ID AS pid, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(l.UN * 1.0 / l.`T-BIL`) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX, l.ID), s AS (SELECT sex, AVG(avg_alb) AS A, AVG(avg_ratio) AS R FROM g GROUP BY sex), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM s) SELECT s.sex, s.A, s.R, s.A - b.B AS diff FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE s.A > b.B ORDER BY s.sex
